mentions.title: King bearings
mentions.snippet: New to this scan. Surfaced in the failure search alongside a report that bearing delamination in a high-performance application was narrowed down to King bearings, with material coming off into the oil. Thread itself not read, so the attribution is from the result snippet only.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 reported as out of spec, slipping onto the grooves rather than holding an interference fit, with a stated risk of spinning the thrust main. Poster says King technical support recommended returning them. Thread still open and unresolved.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the OP reports switching to NOS Clevite thrust bearings that measured in spec.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on the BMW N54: the King factory shipped wrong-size bearings mixed into a standard shrink-wrapped set, with 0.25 shells in place of STD. Thread tells readers to inspect every King set before installing.
mentions.replyNote: Returned HTTP 403 Forbidden again, consistent with every other e90post thread in the ledger; thread content still never read.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX main bearings reported with thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit the BMW S85/S65 block. Thread concludes with a recommendation not to use King main bearings on those engines.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of serving thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Complaint about both a quality-control problem on a King bearing set and the support response the customer received. The title itself is a service criticism, not only a product one.
